nodes.name: Read Follow-ups Due
nodes.notes: The view already excludes leads with replied_at set or a terminal status. This is the first of two guards.

nodes.name: Claim Follow-up Step
nodes.notes: The status filter makes this a claim: a parallel run PATCHing the same row gets zero rows back and skips it.

nodes.name: Render Follow-up Prompt
nodes.notes: Each step has its own intent and length limit, from config/followups.default.json. The prompt receives the real thread, including any human edit, because that is what the prospect actually read.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, max_tokens: $json.max_tokens, temperature: $json.temperature, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.prompt }] }) }}

nodes.name: Claude: Write Follow-up
nodes.notes: Node-level retries cover 429 and 5xx. A malformed or schema-invalid response is handled by the parser node, which sends one correction turn before failing the item.

nodes.name: Parse + Check Follow-up
nodes.notes: A follow-up that reduces to "just following up" is flagged before a human ever sees it.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
      lead_id: $json.lead_id,
      campaign_id: $json.campaign_id,
      company_id: $('Reply Guard').item.json.company_id ?? null,
      kind: $json.kind,
      followup_step: $json.step,
      channel: 'instagram_dm',
      variation: 'conversational',
      message: $json.message,
      char_count: $json.char_count,
      outreach_angle: $('Reply Guard').item.json.outreach_angle ?? null,
      personalisation: $json.references,
      status: 'PENDING_REVIEW',
      model: $json.model,
      prompt_version: $json.prompt_version,
      notes: ($json.review_flags || []).length ? 'Review flags: ' + $json.review_flags.join(', ') : $json.reason
    }) }}

nodes.name: Queue Follow-up For Approval
nodes.notes: Follow-ups go through the same human approval queue as first messages - campaign setting followups.require_human_approval.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_lead_id: $('Parse + Check Follow-up').item.json.lead_id, p_outcome: "NURTURE", p_actor: "n8n:wf11", p_note: "Sequence completed without a reply" }) }}

nodes.name: Move To Nurture
nodes.notes: After the final touch the lead moves to NURTURE for a later recheck - it is not deleted and not messaged again by this sequence.

nodes.name: Classify Failure
nodes.notes: Uses the same classifier as the test suite: 429 backs off, 5xx retries, 401/422 dead-letters immediately.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
    p_lead_id: $json.lead_id || null,
    p_workflow: "wf11-followup-engine",
    p_error_type: $json.error_type || 'unknown',
    p_message: String($json.error_message || $json.error || 'unknown error').slice(0, 2000),
    p_node: "Claude: Write Follow-up",
    p_provider: $json.provider || null,
    p_http_status: $json.http_status || null,
    p_payload: $json.payload || {},
    p_max_retries: 3,
    p_execution_id: $execution.id
  }) }}

nodes.name: Record Failure
nodes.notes: The failed-item queue. The lead returns to its stage with an incremented retry count and an exponential backoff; the rest of the batch is unaffected.
